title: field pack
description: A field pack (packs/<id>.json) is flat data adding glosses and expectations on top of a method manifest -- it never overrides a manifest field, and it needs no code of its own (references/docs/design/multi-method-consensus.md §4.4). tools/method.py globs packs/*.json (except this file) and validates each against this schema. A pack that needs code is a fork, per doctrine. Every `default` below documents what a pack author may omit; jsonschema.validate() does not fill it in at load time -- a pack that omits an optional field simply has no key for it, so any code reading pack[<field>] unconditionally (rather than pack.get(<field>, <default>)) must be written expecting that, not assuming the default already landed in the dict.

id.description: Stable identifier, matches the pack's own filename without the .json extension (e.g. "cs_se" for packs/cs_se.json). tools/method.py checks this at load time.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the routing card and CLI output, e.g. "Computer science / software engineering".

version.description: Semver, watched by tools/check_framework_version.py the same way as methods/*.json -- bump this whenever the pack's own content changes non-trivially.

source_expectations.description: §4.4: renders the card's coverage statement (§2.4 line 4), fills protocol.json.scope.coverage_gaps for a source this field's standard expects but no enabled connector reaches, and generates the manuscript's Limitations paragraph. Required and non-empty -- a pack with nothing to say about source coverage is not yet a pack.

standard.description: The reporting/conduct standard that expects this source for this field, e.g. "Cochrane Handbook 4.5", "SEGRESS 2023".

reachable_via.description: The connectors/<name>.py module id this source is reachable through (must be a real, currently-installed connector -- tools/method.py checks this against connectors.registry.list_source_files()), or null when this workspace cannot reach it at all. null is the expected, honest value for most registry/grey sources today -- it is what makes the source a recorded coverage gap, not a bug to silence.

controlled_vocab.description: Which controlled vocabulary system this field's literature is normally indexed against, if any. Distinct from methods/_schema.json's own search.controlled_vocab (that one is a method-level yes/no gate for the QGS sensitivity check at S3; this one names which system a pack's glosses/question templates should assume).

primary_strategies_allowed.description: Which search strategies this field's standard treats as a valid primary strategy, e.g. adding "snowballing" for cs_se (§3.3: "Snowballing primary only where pack.search.primary_strategies_allowed includes it").

question_template.description: The Q2 template rendered for this field, with one worked example, e.g. "does method A, compared with baseline B, improve metric C on dataset D under condition E?" (§2.1 Q2).

framework_glosses.description: Per-element gloss for whichever question framework this field uses, e.g. {"Population": "imaging modality / anatomy / dataset", "Concept": "method family", "Context": "acceleration, sampling pattern, evaluation setting"} for a PCC-framed imaging pack.

default_capture_fields.description: Candidate charting/classification/extraction fields this field's studies commonly report, offered as a starting point at the pilot-and-freeze stage (S5) -- never a fixed schema, always editable before freeze.

appraisal_instruments_by_design.description: Study-design id (e.g. "rct", "cohort", "case_control", "qualitative") -> appraisal instrument id (e.g. "rob2", "robins-i", "nos", "mmat"), or null when no instrument applies for that design in this field. §1: "rob2 only in clinical packs" -- other packs must not offer it.

confidence_framework.description: §1: "Certainty framework from pack (GRADE in clinical; none in cs_se)".

pooling_unit_identity_proposal.description: Pre-fills synthesis_plan.json's pooling_unit.identity_fields as a *proposal* the human signs at G-Protocol -- e.g. ["dataset", "split_policy", "acceleration", "mask", "coil_setting", "metric_definition"] for an imaging pack. The refusal to pool across non-identical units is a core predicate over the signed plan, never pack code.

preprint_eligibility_default.description: Whether preprints are eligible by default for this field's reviews, offered at protocol time -- always overridable per-review.

label_rule_additions.description: Extra label_rules.requires[]-shaped entries this pack adds on top of the chosen method's own, restricted to check names tools/label_gate.py.CHECK_FUNCTIONS already implements (the same discipline methods/_schema.json's own label_rules.requires[].check follows -- an unknown name fails loudly at evaluation time, never silently ignored). Empty for every M3 pack: the one worked example in §4.4 ("registry_or_grey_source") is v2 (dissent #17), reopened only once an institutional/registry connector ships.
